The '''BAF-X Series Invasion Droid''' was a bipedal [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. BAF-X droids were armed with [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]], and were among the forces used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to defend the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].<ref name="location" />
